name: Hyacinthe Thiandoum
contribution: The first native Archbishop of Dakar and who was elevated to the cardinalate in mid-1976 by Pope Paul VI.
legacy: This person was the first native Archbishop of Dakar and who was elevated to the cardinalate in mid-1976 by Pope Paul VI.

checks.lead: Hyacinthe Thiandoum (2 February 1921 – 18 May 2004) was the first native Archbishop of Dakar (Senegal) and who was elevated to the cardinalate in mid-1976 by Pope Paul VI.
